system.description: A Focus for finding, destroying, and banishing undead, demons, and similar evil creatures.

abilities.name: Sense Evil
abilities.description: Perceive nearby undead, demons, or similar creatures with a minimum roll of 9; the minimum rises to 12 at tier 3.

abilities.name: Inspiring Trust
abilities.description: Allies who share your sense of good and evil gain +1 to their recoveries while in your presence.

abilities.name: Tribulation
abilities.description: Attack up to five nearby evil supernatural creatures of level 2 or less to stun or repel them.

abilities.name: Shield Against Evil
abilities.description: Protect yourself or a touched ally against specified evil creatures, easing defense and granting immunity to mental influence, fear, and possession.

abilities.name: Invisibility to Evil
abilities.description: Make a touched ally effectively invisible to evil creatures of level 3 or less until a ten-minute recovery.

abilities.name: Unearth Evil
abilities.description: Create a mental heat map of qualifying evil creatures within 10 miles and retain awareness of their locations with additional Effort.

abilities.name: Blast Evil
abilities.description: Blast an adjacent immediate area for 3 damage, or 6 damage against undead, demons, and similar creatures.

abilities.name: Righteous Cloak
abilities.description: Radiate wholesome light that automatically deals 4 damage to anyone who touches or makes a melee attack against you.

abilities.name: Rebuke Evil
abilities.description: Command an evil creature you hit with an Intellect attack to pursue a goal, even one that harms it or its allies.

abilities.name: Shrug Off Evil
abilities.description: Become immune to mental influence, fear, and possession, and ignore one wound from an evil creature until a ten-hour recovery.

abilities.name: Fence Out Evil
abilities.description: Surround a short area with cleansing light that damages evil creatures each round and can rebuke them.

abilities.name: Retribution
abilities.description: Call radiant flame onto an immediate area at long range, damaging every creature and one chosen creature more severely.
